[/b]Details about the new NPC:
[spoiler]Meet [b]Ceridwen[/b] the vampire! He hangs out in his cave in a small sewer underneath the station.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/VpgQt7w0/ceridwenmugshot.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/Hfj0nZ8k/ceridwenmugshot.png[/img]
Ceridwen is friendable (platonic) and has events at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 hearts. Ceridwen spends the entire day inside of his lair in the sewer, except for on rainy days when he is able to actually venture around Ferngill Forest during the daytime hours.[/spoiler]
---

Venture beyond the familiar edges of Cindersap Forest to the hidden Ferngill Forest, a wild and untouched corner of the Ferngill Republic. In a secluded clearing, a long-forgotten station has been mysteriously revived by a shadowy figure… and secrets that have slept for decades are waiting for you to discover them. Dare to explore?

Ferngill Forest is a unique seasonal foraging / mining area accessible via Central Station's train network. Foraged plants change with the seasons but summer fish are available year-round from the mysteriously heated pond. Once you've upgraded the axe and pickaxe, you can access the sewer area. Three pillars in the forest use a custom tile property DLL based on the GalaxySword trigger. A mysterious figure sits all day at nearby picnic table, selling a fine selection of mushrooms year-round.

It should be compatible with all other mods, including recolours. 

Note: I am using DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour in the screenshots.
